description: This file is a shared plugin for Smarty, providing a utility function 'smarty_make_timestamp' that converts various string formats into a Unix timestamp, used internally by other Smarty functions.

methods.name: smarty_make_timestamp
methods.description: Converts a given string into a Unix timestamp, handling empty strings, specific date formats, numeric strings, and general date strings via strtotime.

parameters.name: $string
parameters.description: The input date/time string to be converted.
